scripts.spec:demo: cd tools/vibestack && corepack pnpm@10.24.0 run demo
scripts.spec:selftest: cd tools/vibestack && corepack pnpm@10.24.0 run selftest
scripts.test:integration: bun run connector:css && bun test --conditions eliza-source --timeout 120000 ./deploy ./packages ./sites
scripts.test:e2e: bun run connector:css && bun test --conditions eliza-source --timeout 180000 ./tests/e2e
scripts.security: bun run connector:css && bun test --conditions eliza-source --timeout 120000 packages/platform/test/db.test.ts packages/platform/test/api-security.test.ts packages/platform/test/proxy.test.ts packages/platform/test/cloud-auth.pg.test.ts packages/platform/test/notify-retention.pg.test.ts packages/mcp/test/oauth.test.ts packages/mcp/test/pg.test.ts deploy/backend/backend.test.ts deploy/router.test.ts packages/network/test/shared-agent.integration.test.ts packages/observatory/test/staff.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p . && tsc --noEmit -p sites/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/observatory/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p deploy/cloudflare
scripts.observatory: bun run design:build && bun run packages/observatory/src/server.ts
scripts.observatory:db: bun run packages/observatory/db/dev-pg.ts up && bun run packages/observatory/db/seed.ts --from-sim --days 14
scripts.sites:dev: bun run design:build && bun run scripts/sites-dev.ts
scripts.platform:dev: bun run connector:css && bun run scripts/platform-dev.ts
scripts.start:backend: bun run connector:css && bun run deploy/backend/server.ts
scripts.sites:build: bun run design:build && bun run sites/sites.ts
scripts.ui:storybook: bun run design:build && cd packages/ui && bun run storybook
scripts.ui:test: bun run design:build && cd packages/ui && bun run gen && bun run test
scripts.lint:ui: bun run design:build && eslint packages/ui apps --max-warnings 0 --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
